title: Mixed Event — Get Fit & Fly! Muscle Training! — Episode8 Endless Self-Discipline

meta.Event Outline: Haruka thinks of ways to make exercise fun for MORE MORE JUMP!'s fans. By chance, she meets Tsukasa, who invites her to the athletic event Shinobi Battle!

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all for watching the stream and giving me your support today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We didn't win in the end...
But I'm glad we were able to complete that course as a team.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That being said, I plan to continue training in order to learn how to do what I couldn't today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And don't be afraid to come give it a try the next time you visit Nonogi Park.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Congratulations! You were awesome today!>
<I wish I could form a team with you, Haruka...>
<Please do more training videos!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, thanks again for sticking around until the end, you guys! We'll see you during our next stream!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line:
See you again!
Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you both again for doing such a good job today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! We really gave this event everything we had!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we did...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry.
If only I hadn't gotten stuck at the end...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What are you saying, Kiritani?!
I honestly still don't know how you were able to make it to the finish line!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We also lost some time along the way, so it was a team effort in that sense.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I'm glad we trained so hard. It's the reason we succeeded when quite a few groups failed to finish in the end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, please allow me to thank you again for being such a wonderful leader.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you two. This ended up being a really great experience.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This event reminded me of the importance of not giving up. So, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting all the groups that finished to receive a special prize...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Special one-time passes that give us free entry to the training area.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nice! That means we get to try out the latest machines and equipment!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. What a wonderful prize.
Thank you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I hope we can find a day to train as MORE MORE JUMP! and...
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: H-Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Yes! I, uhh...
I wanted to tell you something...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, what would you like to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
U-Umm...
I thought what you did today was really cool!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I don't do very well during P.E. and stuff, but I feel like trying a little harder to become more like you now.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
So... Thank you, Haruka!
I promise to do my best during the next “Everybody MORE MORE DANCE!” stream!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hang on... Are you the one who posted that one comment about not being as athletic as you'd like?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
...!
You remembered?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course I did.
Thank you for always being so supportive.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We promise to keep doing streams that everyone can benefit from.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So let's keep doing our best together.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
...!
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Anyway, bye bye!
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Now then...
I'm sure you guys are all starving after working up such a big sweat.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, let's go grab some barbeque!
I just learned about this really great place the other day!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Barbeque?
That does sound good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can have a party to celebrate your guys' efforts. So, mind leading the way...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, I'll pass.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, why?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I still need to do my evening run.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
H-Hang on a second!
You're still gonna run?! But you just finished competing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know. I'm really tired, which I think is the best time to run that extra mile.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's Haruka for you...
She's not about to budge!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, we gotta get her to go!
Akito, Tenma, say something...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Actually, I might also go for a run.
I feel like exercising a little more.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Me too!
After all, we're used to doing runs in the evening now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's all keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
I hope we get to do this again soon.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me too.
se_run_women_001_3
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?!
You guys are seriously gonna run right now?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They really plan on giving this day everything they have...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We could follow their example, but I feel like they're going a bit overboard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Not so fast!
I wanna run with you!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: After listening to you guys talk, I also feel like running now, you know?!
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-Wait, I wanna run too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you sure? My plan was to do four kilometers.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Four kilometers...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: N-No, I can do that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-Me too...! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Then, follow me!
se_run_women_001_1
se_run_women_001_2
